apps.label: Rusty XR Quest OpenXR GLES
apps.description: Public OpenXR/OpenGL ES feasibility APK. It renders static left/right diagnostic grids and logs public GLES plus SurfaceTexture/OES feasibility payloads.

deviceProfiles.label: GLES OpenXR smoke test
deviceProfiles.description: Short OpenXR/GLES validation profile for frame-loop and static-grid checks.

runtimeProfiles.label: GLES static stereo grid
runtimeProfiles.description: Runs the OpenXR/GLES feasibility path with no camera, broker, decoder, or effect stack. The app creates SurfaceTexture/OES output surfaces but does not feed decoded frames yet.
